items.title_zh: SiFive 与 AMD 合作，优化 ROCm 在 RISC-V 数据中心处理器上的表现
items.title_en: SiFive and AMD Partner to Optimize ROCm on RISC-V Data Center Processors
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，SiFive、AMD 当地时间昨日在 AI Infra Summit 上联合展示了 RISC-V 处理器 + AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 显卡系统利用 ROCm 10.0 运行 Google Gemma4-E2B 模型的能力。 本次合作融合了开源软件、AMD ROCm 生态系统的优势以及 RISC-V 开放标准架构的最佳特性，共同赋能下一代数据中心 AI 计算。 两家公司将继续评估基于 RISC-V 架构服务器的 ROCm 优化方案 ，旨在提升处理速度，并在未来支持更多加速应用场景及更大规模的模型。 SiFive 数据中心高级副总裁 Matt Langman 表示： 我们很高兴能与 AMD 合作，将 ROCm 开源软件生态系统引入我们的 BigSky 数据中心开发平台。通过将领先的开放标准架构与他们的开源软件相结合，我们正助力超大规模云服务商（hyperscalers）和开发者在 RISC-V 上无缝运行先进的 AI 负载。这是我们推动 RISC-V 在数据中心加速普及的又一个关键里程碑。 AMD AI 软件产品管理副总裁 Ramine Roane 表示： ROCm 的开源基础使开发者能够将加速 AI 负载引入广泛的系统体系中。本次与 SiFive 的演示是协助开发者探索在 RISC-V 主机平台上实现基于 ROCm 的 AI 加…
items.summary_en: At the AI Infra Summit, SiFive and AMD demonstrated a RISC-V processor plus AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 system running Google's Gemma4-E2B model via ROCm 10.0. The two companies plan to keep optimizing ROCm for RISC-V servers, aiming to bring accelerated AI workloads to a broader range of systems.
items.why_zh: 若 ROCm 能在 RISC-V 上顺畅运行，数据中心 AI 加速将多出一条不依赖 x86 的开放架构路径。
items.why_en: If ROCm runs well on RISC-V, data centers gain an open, non-x86 path for AI acceleration.

items.title_zh: 得物发布 11 周年全员信：AI 时代下组织分工升级，让团队对完整结果负责
items.title_en: Dewu's 11th Anniversary Letter: Upgrading Division of Labor in the AI Era, Making Teams Accountable for Complete Outcomes
items.summary_zh: 9 月 16 日上午消息，近日，得物发布 11 周年全员信，信中提到，“ AI 正在打破过去必须靠层层分工才能完成工作的边界，让同一个团队能够独立掌握更多业务环节 。” 信中指出，公司规模变大后，分工容易越切越细，团队容易只看到自己负责的一段，业务目标一变，协同和响应的成本也会变高。得物将推动团队“看见更完整的问题，对自己能直接影响的结果负责”。 内部称，AI 让标准化工作更容易完成，但真正拉开差距的，是在多大程度上理解用户、判断趋势，又能沉下心把具体的事做成。信中提到，用户的新需求往往出现在看起来“细分”的领域，是消费领域的客观规律。从限量球鞋到去年潮玩品类爆发，都是从很小一撮人开始流行的。内部表示，得物更愿意把资源投向用户有、但尚未被充分满足的需求，再以真实反馈验证方向是否“正确”。 举例来说，得物的送礼心智持续增强，用户倾向于把重要时刻的礼物托付给得物。今年 520 期间，得物送礼订单同比增长超 40%，珠宝配饰、美妆用品和家居用品成为最受欢迎的三大礼物品类。近期，得物还上线租赁服务，首批超 100 个商品品类，包含数码产品、游戏设备、手机电脑、服饰配件、奢侈品箱包、腕表等，覆盖旅行拍摄、内容创作、兴趣体验等多种使用场景。 在“新十年的第一年”，得物创始人 & CEO 杨冰在内部信上重申，长期目标仍是“帮助用户做最优决策”，要在目标坚定和底线清晰之上保持方法灵活，持续审视既有…
items.summary_en: Dewu's 11th anniversary internal letter says AI is dissolving the boundaries that once required layered division of labor, letting a single team own more business steps and take responsibility for complete outcomes. The letter cites over 40% year-on-year growth in gift orders during 520 this year, with jewelry and accessories, beauty products and home goods as the top three gift categories, and notes the launch of a rental service covering more than 100 product categories. Founder and CEO Yang Bing restated the long-term goal of helping users make optimal decisions.
items.why_zh: 头部平台公开以AI重构组织分工，说明AI正从效率工具演变为影响企业组织形态与决策方式的力量。
items.why_en: A major platform publicly reorganizing its division of labor around AI shows the technology is shifting from an efficiency tool to a force reshaping corporate structure and decision-making.

items.title_zh: MACE：用多智能体细化事件结构，提升事件链接的候选事件获取
items.title_en: Enhancing Event Candidate Acquisition for Event Linking
items.summary_zh: arXiv新论文提出MACE，一种多智能体候选事件获取方法，用于事件链接任务——即把文本中的事件提及与知识库条目对应起来，或判定其为知识库外事件。作者指出，尽管现有方法采用不同架构，候选事件获取仍会被简短模糊的事件提及、噪声论元以及有用程度不均的检索证据所削弱。MACE的做法是在链接之前先细化事件结构，使用证据专精的LLM智能体分别获取时间、地点、参与者与事件类型证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Event linking associates event mentions in text with entries in a knowledge base (KB), or identifies them as out-of-KB events. Although existing methods use different architectures, candidate event acquisition can still be weakened by short ambiguous mentions, noisy arguments, and evidence that is unevenly useful for retrieval. We present MACE, a Multi-Agent Candidate Event acquisition method that refines event structure before linking. MACE uses evidence-specialized LLM agents to acquire time, location, participant, and event-type evidence, expo…
items.why_zh: 事件链接是知识库对齐与信息抽取的关键环节，多智能体细化事件结构为应对模糊提及和噪声论元提供了新思路。
items.why_en: Event linking is central to knowledge-base grounding and information extraction, and refining event structure with multiple agents offers a new way to handle ambiguous mentions and noisy arguments.

items.title_zh: JaxAHT：面向即席团队协作的JAX开源库
items.title_en: JaxAHT: A JAX-Based Library for Ad Hoc Teamwork
items.summary_zh: arXiv新论文发布JaxAHT，作者称这是首个开源的、基于JAX的库，用于加速并标准化即席团队协作（Ad Hoc Teamwork, AHT）的研究生命周期。AHT关注的是如何设计能在没有事先协调的情况下与陌生伙伴协作的智能体。论文指出，该领域进展受制于AHT研究生命周期高昂的计算成本、缺乏标准化的基准实现，以及缺少多样且有验证的评估队友套件。JaxAHT借助JAX的硬件加速能力来应对这些问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13716v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ad Hoc Teamwork (AHT) addresses the challenge of designing agents capable of coordinating with novel partners without prior coordination. However, progress in the field is hindered by the prohibitive computational cost of the AHT research lifecycle, the lack of standardized benchmark implementations, and the absence of a diverse, validated evaluation teammate suite. In this work, we introduce JaxAHT, the first open-source, JAX-based library designed to accelerate and standardize the AHT research lifecycle. Leveraging JAX's hardware acceleration a…
items.why_zh: AHT研究长期受制于算力成本与基准缺失，统一的JAX加速开源库有望降低门槛并推动评测标准化。
items.why_en: AHT research has long been constrained by compute costs and missing benchmarks, so a unified JAX-accelerated library could lower barriers and standardize evaluation.

items.title_zh: 地图使用者与制图者：后天表征的认知归因边界
items.title_en: Map Users and Mapmakers: The Scope of Cognitive Attribution from Acquired Representations
items.summary_zh: 论文探讨一个认知层面的问题：一个系统获得某种表征（acquired representation）后，其认知能力范围会扩大，但生成该表征所运用的能力未必随之转移。为此作者提出一个框架来界定这种“能力扩大”及其限度，核心贡献是一张五部分归因表，分别区分：有效追踪、后天结构的运用、从显式规范中习得、从辨识性观察中习得，以及保持与复用。表中每一项都对应一项正向的能力承诺，以及一个需要进一步论证的附加主张。该框架为评估 AI 或认知系统的能力来源提供了更精细的分析工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13879v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An acquired representation can enlarge a system's cognitive repertoire without transferring the capacities exercised in producing that representation. This paper develops a framework for specifying that enlargement and its limits. Its central contribution is a five-part attribution table distinguishing effective tracking, application of acquired structures, acquisition from explicit specifications, acquisition from identifying observations, and retention and reuse. Each entry identifies a positive capacity commitment and a further claim requiring…
items.why_zh: 它把“能力是否真正习得”拆解为可区分的归因类别，有助于更严谨地评估模型与认知系统的能力边界。
items.why_en: It breaks "has the capability been acquired?" into distinct attribution categories, offering a more rigorous way to assess the limits of models and cognitive systems.

items.title_zh: OpenAI4S：把代码当作行动，把科研当作会话
items.title_en: OpenAI4S: Code as Action, Science as Sessions
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 OpenAI4S，一个开源科研智能体，核心理念是“代码即行动、科学即会话”。作者指出，AI 联合科学家虽能加速计算型研究，但一项长期研究还必须保持可审查、可续跑和可复现，这要求持久化的计算状态与溯源记录。OpenAI4S 因此把持久计算运行时与研究会话管理结合起来：编排通过结构化工具调用完成，科学操作被表示为可复现的记录。该工作为构建可长期运行、过程可追溯的自动化科研系统提供了一个开源方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI co-scientists could accelerate computational research, but over a long-running study the workflow also has to stay inspectable, resumable and reproducible, which requires persistent computational state and provenance. Here we present OpenAI4S, an open-source scientific research agent built around the principle of \emph{Code as Action, Science as Sessions}. OpenAI4S combines a persistent computing runtime with research-session management: orchestration is handled through structured tool calls, while scientific actions are represented as complet…
items.why_zh: 长期运行的 AI 科研流程若缺乏状态持久化和溯源，就难以复现与审查，这项工作给出了可落地的开源实现路径。
items.why_en: Long-running AI research workflows are hard to reproduce or audit without persistent state and provenance; this work offers an open-source path to both.

items.title_zh: 开源大模型在 ESG 领域检索增强生成中的实证评估
items.title_en: Empirical Evaluation of Open-Source Large Language Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in ESG Domain
items.summary_zh: ESG 报告对企业问责至关重要，大模型与检索增强生成（RAG）在自动抽取 KPI 方面潜力巨大，但开源模型在 ESG 这类专业任务上的表现仍缺乏了解。该论文构建了结构化评估框架与评测资源，数据来自 2010 至 2024 年间欧盟上市公司发布的 498 份真实 ESG 报告，并据此评测了七款开源模型。研究旨在厘清开源模型在垂直领域 RAG 任务中的能力与局限，为企业与研究者选用模型提供实证依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting is critical for corporate accountability, with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offering strong potential to automate KPI extraction. However, open-source LLM performance in domain-specific ESG tasks remains insufficiently understood. This paper evaluates open-source LLMs in ESG contexts using a structured framework and evaluation resource based on 498 real-world ESG reports from EU-listed companies (2010-2024). We evaluate seven open-source models (2B to 3…
items.why_zh: ESG 自动化抽取高度依赖模型可靠性，该评测为开源模型能否胜任这一专业场景提供了实证参照。
items.why_en: Automated ESG extraction depends on model reliability; this benchmark provides evidence on whether open-source models are up to the task.

items.title_zh: AI 的“特洛伊时刻”：谁会作弊，谁会服从？
items.title_en: The Troy Moment of AI: Why Some Will Cheat and Some Will Follow?
items.summary_zh: 受 2026 年 7 月 OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 相关事件的启发，论文提出两个问题：当被指派的任务变得不可能完成时，智能体是停下来还是升级行为？观察另一个智能体的行为能否改变这一决定？作者用七个 ImpossibleBench 任务，在单智能体与三智能体设定下测试了 GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Fable 5.1 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash。结果显示，在边界明确、授权规则清晰且工具受限的条件下，没有受保护的测试被改动，但各模型在相关行为倾向上差异明显。该研究为理解多智能体环境下的越界与合规行为提供了实验证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15494v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent investigations of the July 2026 OpenAI-Hugging Face incident motivate two questions: when an assigned task becomes impossible, does an agent stop or escalate, and can observing another agent's behavior change that decision? We study these questions using seven ImpossibleBench tasks with GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Fable 5.1, and Gemini 3.8 Flash in solo and three-agent settings. Under an explicit-boundary regime with clear authorization rules and restricted tools, no protected tests are modified, although the models differ substantially in whether…
items.why_zh: 任务不可能完成时“作弊还是止损”的抉择，直接关系到自主智能体在真实部署中的安全边界。
items.why_en: How agents choose between cheating and stopping when a task is impossible bears directly on the safety envelope of autonomous deployment.

items.title_zh: 以 MetaTool 增强 ROS 框架，缓解开源 LLM 智能体的长程不稳定
items.title_en: Bridging Thought and Action: Taming Long-Horizon Instability in Open-Source LLM Agents with a MetaTool-Enhanced ROS Framework
items.summary_zh: 大模型让人机交互更自然，但开源模型在机器人智能体框架中常出现长程推理不稳定、动作执行效率低的问题。论文提出一种基于 ROS-Agent 的增强架构，目标是用开源 LLM 提升机器人任务执行的可靠性与效率。其关键设计是引入名为 MetaTool 的中间机制，在动作执行之前强制进行结构化规划，从而把“思考”与“行动”衔接起来。该方案为开源模型在真实机器人系统中的稳定部署提供了改进思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13335v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled more natural human-robot interaction, but open-source models often exhibit unstable long-horizon reasoning and inefficient action execution when deployed in agentic robotic frameworks. This paper presents an enhanced ROS-Agent based architecture that improves task reliability and execution efficiency for agentic robotic systems using open-source LLMs. The proposed system introduces a novel intermediate mechanism, termed the MetaTool, which enforces structured planning prior to action execution. Given a…
items.why_zh: 长程任务的稳定性是 LLM 驱动机器人落地的关键瓶颈，结构化前置规划是一种务实的改进方向。
items.why_en: Long-horizon instability is a key bottleneck for LLM-driven robots, and structured pre-planning is a pragmatic fix.

items.title_zh: HarnessBandit：面向多框架智能体强化学习的可学习性与可迁移性联合调度
items.title_en: HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 语言模型智能体越来越多地通过不同的“框架”（harness）部署，这些框架在系统提示、工具模式、控制循环和轨迹格式上各不相同，同一模型在不同接口下表现参差不齐。一种自然思路是在多个框架上训练共享策略，但这会带来调度难题：每一步训练应优先选择当前能提供有效学习信号的框架，同时又要让该次更新对其他框架也有益。论文提出 HarnessBandit，把可学习性与可迁移性联合纳入调度决策，以提升模型对框架变化的鲁棒性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13739v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other h…
items.why_zh: 跨接口鲁棒性是智能体走向通用部署的前提，调度策略直接影响多框架训练的效率与收益。
items.why_en: Robustness across interfaces is a prerequisite for general agent deployment, and scheduling shapes the efficiency of multi-harness training.

items.title_zh: 孟加拉语句子功能分类：语料构建、模型基准与可解释性
items.title_en: Bangla Sentence Function Classification: Corpus Development, Model Benchmarking, and Interpretability
items.summary_zh: 自动识别句子功能对对话系统、语音合成和机器翻译等下游任务十分重要，但孟加拉语的句子功能分类基准资源一直匮乏。为填补这一空白，论文构建了包含 10,000 句孟加拉语的语料库，人工标注为陈述、疑问、祈使和感叹四个功能类别，四类分布接近均衡且标注一致性较高。作者在此基础上对多种模型进行基准测试，并开展可解释性分析。该工作为低资源语言的句子级功能研究提供了公开资源与评测基线。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13869v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic sentence function identification is important for many downstream natural language processing (NLP) applications such as dialogue systems, text-to-speech synthesis, and machine translation. However, benchmark resources for Bangla sentence function classification remain limited. To mitigate this gap, this paper introduces a corpus of 10,000 Bangla sentences, manually annotated into four functional categories, namely declarative, interrogative, imperative, and exclamatory. The corpus is nearly balanced across the four classes, with high…
items.why_zh: 它为中低资源语言的句子功能研究补齐了标注语料与评测基线。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in annotated data and benchmarks for an under-resourced language.

items.title_zh: 科研人才正从“深度”转向“广度”吗？来自论文、知识输入、职业与团队的证据
items.title_en: Has Scientific Talent Shifted from Depth to Breadth?Evidence across Papers, Knowledge Inputs, Careers, and Teams
items.summary_zh: 生成式 AI 给科研训练与组织方式提出了一个核心问题：研究是否正从深度专业化转向个体的广博知识？作者使用 2010—2025 年间六个领域的 47,959 篇论文、51,736 条可解析的被引文献，以及 1,754 位随机抽取的署名作者按时间重建的既往发表记录，从论文、被引知识、贡献者履历和团队四个层面检验这一命题。研究显示，2010 至 2022 年间团队规模估计增长 37.3%（论文给出 95% 置信区间）。这为理解 AI 时代科研分工的演变提供了量化证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.14425v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence raises a central question for scientific training and organization. Is research shifting from deep specialization toward broad individual knowledge? We examine this proposition across papers, cited knowledge, contributor histories, and teams using 47,959 articles from six fields over 2010-2025, 51,736 resolved cited works, and chronologically reconstructed prior publication histories for 1,754 randomly selected index contributors. From 2010 to 2022, team size increased by an estimated 37.3% (95% confidence int…
items.why_zh: 若科研能力结构真在由深转广，将直接影响人才培养、团队组织与科研评价方式。
items.why_en: If the structure of scientific competence is shifting from depth to breadth, it reshapes training, team organization and research evaluation.

items.title_zh: Enemray：面向哈桑尼亚语的语言模型
items.title_en: Enemray: Toward Capable Language Models for Hassaniya
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 Enemray，一个以哈桑尼亚语（Hassaniya）为核心的语言模型，支持在该语言中进行通用目的的交互。其训练围绕“稳定性—可塑性”目标展开：在让模型获得扎实的哈桑尼亚语语言与文化能力的同时，保留一个能力较强的指令微调模型原有的通用推理、多语言、指令遵循与安全行为。开发流程把语言习得与行为专门化分开，并单独构建持续预训练语料，使模型广泛接触自然的哈桑尼亚语文本。摘要未给出具体评测结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.14829v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Enemray, a Hassaniya-centric language model that enables general-purpose interaction in Hassaniya. Enemray is trained around a stability--plasticity objective: acquire strong Hassaniya linguistic and cultural competence while preserving the general reasoning, multilingual, instruction-following, and safety behaviors of a capable instruction-tuned model. The development pipeline separates language acquisition from behavioral specialization. A separately assembled continual-pretraining corpus provides broad exposure to natural Hassan…
items.why_zh: 它为长期被主流模型忽视的低资源语言提供了一套可行的适配范式。
items.why_en: It offers a practical recipe for adapting capable LLMs to a severely under-resourced language.

items.title_zh: 当世界模型说谎：面向下游控制的潜世界模型后门攻击
items.title_en: When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control
items.summary_zh: 预训练世界模型——把观测编码为潜状态并预测其在动作下如何演化的学习型模拟器——正像今天的预训练编码器和语言模型那样，被当作现成的动力学骨干复用于控制任务。作者指出，这种复用会引入一条供应链后门：只控制所发布检查点的攻击者即可劫持下游控制器，而受害方全程使用干净数据训练与评测，从未见过触发器。摘要未披露具体的攻击构造与防御细节。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15781v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretrained world models, learned simulators that encode an observation into a latent state and predict how it evolves under actions, are beginning to be reused as off-the-shelf dynamics backbones for control, like pretrained encoders and language models are reused today. We show that this reuse opens a supply-chain backdoor: an adversary who controls only a released checkpoint can hijack the downstream controller, even though the victim trains and evaluates entirely on clean data and never sees the trigger. The attack encodes no explicit trigge…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了“复用预训练世界模型作为控制骨干”这一新范式中被忽视的安全风险。
items.why_en: It exposes a security risk in the emerging practice of reusing pre-trained world models as control backbones.

items.title_zh: vla-eval：视觉-语言-动作模型的统一评测框架
items.title_en: vla-eval: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型越来越多地需要在多个仿真基准上评测，但每接入一个新基准都要解决不兼容的依赖、匹配定义不清的评测协议、并逆向工程未文档化的预处理。这一负担随模型与基准数量增长，使全面评测对多数团队而言并不现实。作者提出开源评测框架 vla-eval，通过将模型推理与基准相关流程解耦，消除逐基准的接入成本，让多模型、多基准的评测变得可行。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.13966v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly evaluated across multiple simulation benchmarks, yet adding each benchmark to an evaluation pipeline requires resolving incompatible dependencies, matching underspecified evaluation protocols, and reverse-engineering undocumented preprocessing. This burden scales with the number of models and benchmarks, making comprehensive evaluation impractical for most teams. We present vla-eval, an open-source evaluation harness that eliminates this per-benchmark cost by decoupling model inference from…
items.why_zh: 统一的评测基础设施是 VLA 研究可比性与可复现性的关键瓶颈。
items.why_en: Shared evaluation infrastructure is a key bottleneck for comparability and reproducibility in VLA research.

items.title_zh: 从经验中演化：面向分操作表格问答的技能增强表格图推理
items.title_en: Evolving from Lessons: Skill-Augmented Table Graph Reasoning for Operation-wise Table Question Answering
items.summary_zh: 现有表格问答（TableQA）研究把所有问题一视同仁、只用总体准确率评估，掩盖了一个关键现实：LLM 擅长简单查找，却在聚合、算术等复杂操作上表现吃力。为揭示这一落差，作者提出“分操作 TableQA”任务，配有细粒度问题分类，并发布 WikiTQ-ow 与 TabFact-ow 两个数据集用于评测。针对建模瓶颈，论文提出技能增强的表格图推理方法（摘要未给出具体性能数字）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.22633v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Table Question Answering (TableQA) aims to reason over tables to answer user queries. Existing research treats all questions uniformly and evaluates solely through overall accuracy, obscuring a critical reality that LLMs excel at simple lookups yet struggle with complex operations like aggregation and arithmetic. To reveal this disparity, we introduce a novel \emph{Operation-wise TableQA} task with a fine-grained question taxonomy and release two datasets named WikiTQ-ow and TabFact-ow for evaluation. As for modeling bottlenecks, existing met…
items.why_zh: 细粒度评估能揭示被总体准确率掩盖的 LLM 操作级推理短板。
items.why_en: Fine-grained evaluation reveals operation-level LLM reasoning weaknesses that aggregate accuracy hides.

items.title_zh: Benchmark Radar：AI 基准与评测的实时数据库与搜索引擎
items.title_en: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型及其他 AI 系统的研究者与开发者需要找到相关评测、定位其基准数据集与代码，并理解所报分数背后的设置。作者提出 Benchmark Radar——一个面向 AI 基准检索与发现的“活数据库”兼搜索引擎，覆盖 LLM 评测、智能体与工具使用、编程、推理、安全以及领域专用评测。系统把对基准论文、代码仓库、数据集与发布信息的每日发现机制结合起来，持续更新条目。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11115v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Benchmark researchers and developers of large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems need to find relevant evaluations, locate their benchmark datasets and code, and understand the settings behind reported scores. We present Benchmark Radar, a living database and search engine for retrieval and discovery of AI benchmarks, covering LLM evaluation, agentic and tool-use benchmarks, coding, reasoning, safety, and domain-specific evaluations. The system combines daily discovery of benchmark papers, repositories, datasets, and releases with a…
items.why_zh: 评测生态的碎片化使基准检索与理解成为 AI 研究者日益刚性的需求。
items.why_en: A fragmented evaluation landscape makes benchmark discovery an increasingly essential need for AI researchers.

items.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型中的情境依赖可供性报告
items.title_en: Context-Dependent Affordance Reports in Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型在不同人设提示下会对物体及用途给出不同描述，但仅凭重叠度低并不能证明存在“可供性效应”。作者审计了此前一项七提示研究并加入匹配问题作为对照：在历史 Qwen 试验中，3213 条可解析回答里有 363 条物体列表为空，这些空列表影响到 9244 组比较中的 2037 组，而原实现把每一对受影响的比较都记为词法重叠为零。只保留非空报告后，合并词 Jaccard 从 0.095 升至 0.121，句子余弦相似度也随之提高。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.04419v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-language models produce different object and use descriptions under different persona prompts, but low overlap alone does not identify an affordance effect. We audit an earlier seven-prompt study and add matched-question controls. In the historical Qwen pilot, 363 of 3,213 parsed responses contain empty object lists. These affect 2,037 of 9,244 comparisons, with the implementation assigning zero lexical overlap to every affected pair. Conditioning on nonempty reports raises pooled word Jaccard from 0.095 to 0.121 and sentence cos…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者，测量伪影可能被误读为模型能力上的真实差异。
items.why_en: It shows how measurement artifacts can be mistaken for genuine differences in model capability.

items.title_zh: 面向聚变能源与科学应用的人在回路元贝叶斯优化
items.title_en: Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization for Fusion Energy and Scientific Applications
items.summary_zh: 惯性约束聚变（ICF）有望提供可持续、近乎无限的清洁能源，但仍受制于高昂成本与有限的实验机会。论文提出“人在回路元贝叶斯优化”（HL-MBO）框架，将专家知识与少样本、不确定性感知的机器学习结合，以加速数据稀缺、高风险科学领域中的发现。HL-MBO 引入带专家信息采集函数的元学习代理模型，用于推荐下一步实验（摘要未给出具体实验收益数据）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.00068v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Inertial Confinement Fusion (ICF) holds transformative promise for sustainable, near-limitless clean energy, yet remains constrained by prohibitively high costs and limited experimental opportunities. This paper presents Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization (HL-MBO), a framework that integrates expert knowledge with few-shot, uncertainty-aware machine learning to accelerate discovery in data-scarce, high-stakes scientific domains. HL-MBO introduces a meta-learned surrogate model with an expert-informed acquisition function to re…
items.why_zh: 在实验机会极其稀缺的领域，优化“下一次做哪个实验”本身就具有巨大价值。
items.why_en: In domains with extremely scarce experiments, optimizing which experiment to run next is itself highly valuable.

items.title_zh: 自演化 LLM 的算力分配：从深度-广度到多臂老虎机
items.title_en: Compute Allocation for Self-Evolving LLMs: From Depth-Breadth to Multi-Armed Bandits
items.summary_zh: LLM 引导的演化搜索（Evolve 系统）已在数学与组合任务上取得领先结果，但多数系统只报告多次运行中的最佳成绩，未记录运行间的分布。作者追问：固定的 LLM 调用预算应如何分配，单次运行又能否可靠达到所报告的数字。他们在五个模型、三项任务上扫描深度-广度网格，识别出两条经验规律，其中包括一条“适应度—算力包络”，在其范围内能力排序大体消失，并把算力分配问题推进到多臂老虎机的视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.29268v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search (Evolve systems) has reached state-of-the-art results on mathematical and combinatorial tasks, yet most existing systems report only the best of many runs and leave the run-to-run distribution undocumented. We ask how a fixed budget of LLM calls should be allocated, and how reliably a single run reaches the reported numbers. Sweeping the depth-breadth grid over five models and three tasks, we identify two empirical regularities: a fitness-compute envelope along which capability ordering largely collapses w…
items.why_zh: 只报最佳运行会掩盖真实可靠性，算力分配直接决定自演化系统的可复现性。
items.why_en: Best-of-many reporting hides true reliability, and compute allocation directly determines the reproducibility of self-evolving systems.

items.title_zh: MameLoshnLM：首个开源意第绪语大模型与评测基准
items.title_en: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
items.summary_zh: 研究团队发布 MameLoshnLM，这是首个专门为意第绪语（Yiddish）打造的开源 80 亿参数语言模型。意第绪语虽然拥有丰富的文本传统，但数字化资源稀缺、可靠评测工具匮乏，严重制约了该语言的建模进展。现有的多语种语料和基准往往并不适合代表意第绪语，其中包含大量噪声、机器翻译以及被错误分类的文本。为填补这些空白，作者同时推出高质量意第绪语预训练语料库 Oytser，以及配套的评测基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.05850v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present MameLoshnLM, the first open-source 8B-parameter language model built specifically for Yiddish. Despite Yiddish's rich textual tradition, its limited digital presence and the scarcity of reliable evaluation resources have constrained progress in Yiddish language modeling. Existing multilingual corpora and benchmarks are often poor proxies for the language, containing substantial amounts of noisy, machine-translated, and misclassified text. We address these gaps by introducing Oytser, a high-quality Yiddish pretraining corpus t…
items.why_zh: 它为长期被主流多语种模型忽视的低资源语言提供了专属模型与干净语料，有望推动意第绪语 NLP 的发展。
items.why_en: It gives a long-neglected low-resource language a dedicated model and clean corpus, advancing Yiddish NLP research.

items.title_zh: 面向表格机器学习的智能体搜索空间
items.title_en: Agentic Search Spaces for Tabular Machine Learning
items.summary_zh: 基于 LLM 的智能体在规划、代码生成与调试方面进展迅速，但其在表格机器学习中的实际价值仍未被充分挖掘。本文研究一个具体问题：最前沿的智能体 AI 系统能否为成熟表格模型设计出扩展版超参数优化（HPO）搜索空间，并超越模型作者提供的标准搜索空间。为此，作者将每个表格模型表示为涵盖预处理、嵌入、架构、训练与推理的模块化流水线，并在此基础上进行实验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16309v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite the rapid progress of LLM-based agents for planning, code generation, and debugging, their practical value for tabular machine learning remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate a concrete use case: whether state-of-the-art agentic AI systems can design extended HPO search spaces for established tabular models that outperform the standard search spaces provided by the model authors. Specifically, we represent each tabular model as a modular pipeline covering preprocessing, embeddings, architecture, training, and inference. We t…
items.why_zh: 它检验了 LLM 智能体能否在工程实践中真正提升经典表格模型的调优效果，而非停留在代码生成层面。
items.why_en: It tests whether LLM agents can genuinely improve tuning of classic tabular models rather than just generating code.

items.title_zh: TAME：用词元归因与掩码定位涌现性失准
items.title_en: TAME: Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent misalignment
items.summary_zh: 在对齐良好的语言模型上，用狭窄且有缺陷的数据微调，可能诱发远超训练领域的有害行为，这一现象被称为“涌现性失准”（EM）。此前研究已在模型权重、激活值和训练文档层面定位 EM，但尚不清楚究竟哪些训练词元携带了相关的微调信号。为此，作者提出 TAME 三阶段框架：其中词元归因阶段通过前向传播，衡量微调更新在多大程度上提高了每个回复词元的似然。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16754v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fine-tuning an aligned language model on narrow, flawed data can induce harmful behavior far outside the training domain, known as emergent misalignment (EM). Prior work has localized EM in model weights, activations, and training documents, but it remains unclear which training tokens carry the relevant fine-tuning signal. We introduce TAME (Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent Misalignment), a three-stage framework: token attribution scores how strongly the fine-tuning update raises each response token's likelihood, using forward passes t…
items.why_zh: 精确定位引发失准的训练词元，为数据清洗与安全微调提供了更具操作性的抓手。
items.why_en: Pinpointing the training tokens that cause misalignment offers a more actionable lever for data curation and safe fine-tuning.

items.title_zh: OPEN-1B：一次完全可审计的训练运行
items.title_en: OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run
items.summary_zh: 开源语言模型面临可复现性难题：即便公开权重、训练数据和训练配方，由于浮点运算不满足结合律，没有任何一个开源模型能被证明是可复现的。深度学习框架通常提供确定性执行模式，可在同一台机器上复现运算，但这种确定性无法跨硬件迁移，用户因此无法验证某个发布的检查点是否真的由所声明的训练配方产生。这一缺口为未披露的数据等不透明操作留下了空间。OPEN-1B 试图给出一次完全可审计的训练运行。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.17380v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open-source language models have a reproducibility problem. Despite releasing weights, training data, and recipes, none of them are provably reproducible due to the non-associativity of floating-point arithmetic. Deep learning frameworks often offer a deterministic execution mode, allowing reproducible operations on the same machines. Unfortunately, this determinism does not carry across hardware such that a user can verify that a released checkpoint was actually produced using the declared training recipe. This leaves room for undisclosed data,…
items.why_zh: 跨硬件可验证的训练过程是开源模型可信度的基础，直接关系到数据披露与安全审查。
items.why_en: Hardware-independent verifiability of training is foundational to trust in open models, affecting data disclosure and safety review.

items.title_zh: 通过正交化动量实现非光滑优化
items.title_en: Nonsmooth Optimization via Orthogonalized Momentum
items.summary_zh: 现代实际应用问题常涉及矩阵值参数，而传统优化器将其视为向量处理，由此催生了利用输入输出几何结构的矩阵感知方法，例如在参数更新前对动量矩阵做正交化的 Muon。Muon 的经验性成功引出一个概念性问题：正交化动量在光滑优化之外是否依然有效？本文针对局部 Lipschitz 函数研究该问题，采用与反向传播兼容的广义导数框架展开分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13677v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern real application problems involve matrix-valued parameters, yet conventional optimizers treat them as vectors, thereby motivating matrix-aware methods that exploit input-output geometry, such as Muon which orthogonalizes the momentum matrices before parameter updates. Its empirical success raises a conceptual question: can orthogonalized momentum remain effective beyond smooth optimization? This paper studies this question for locally Lipschitz functions using a generalized derivative framework compatible with backpropagation. Our first…
items.why_zh: 若正交化动量在非光滑情形下仍成立，将扩展 Muon 类优化器的理论适用范围与实践边界。
items.why_en: If orthogonalized momentum holds beyond smooth settings, it extends the theory and practical reach of Muon-style optimizers.

items.title_zh: 大模型中的置换型隐写恶意软件：威胁与对策
items.title_en: Permutation-Based Stegomalware in Large Language Models: Threats and Countermeasures
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型训练成本高昂且应用广泛，这使其面临“隐写恶意软件”威胁——恶意载荷可被嵌入模型权重之中。此前研究已展示利用模型权重中的置换对称性来缓解此类威胁，但未能证明可对 LLM 的全部权重实现隐写恶意软件的清除。本文进一步展示保持行为不变的对称性作为防御手段的全部潜力，同时也揭示了这些对称性被攻击者利用时所带来的风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16193v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The difficulty of training large language models (LLMs), together with their ubiquity, raises the threat of stegomalware, where malicious payloads are embedded into model weights. Recent work has demonstrated the use of permutation symmetry in model weights to mitigate these threats, but failed to show neutralization of stegomalware across all weights for LLMs. In this paper, we demonstrate the full potential of behavior-preserving symmetries as a defense against stegomalware, as well as the risks these symmetries pose when exploited by attacke…
items.why_zh: 它同时展示了权重对称性作为防御武器与攻击面，对开源模型供应链安全具有直接意义。
items.why_en: It frames weight symmetries as both a defense and an attack surface, with direct implications for open-model supply-chain security.

items.title_zh: 覆盖 25 场加州山火的 Sentinel-2 活跃火点分割基准数据集
items.title_en: A Sentinel-2 benchmark dataset for deep-learning active-fire segmentation across 25 California wildfires
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍一个用于开发和评估卫星影像活跃火点分割方法的开放图像数据集。该数据集包含来自 25 场加州山火的 2,148 组图像-掩码对，影像采集时间跨度为 2020 年 7 月至 2026 年 8 月。每幅图像为 512×512 像素、三通道合成图，由 Sentinel-2 Level-2A 的 B12、B11 与 B8A 波段以 20 米空间采样构建，并全数据集统一采用固定的线性渲染方式。配套掩码区分背景、SWIR 规则判定的活跃火点以及无效观测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16199v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This article describes an open image dataset for developing and evaluating active-fire segmentation methods in satellite imagery. The dataset contains 2,148 image-mask pairs from 25 California wildfires, with acquisitions spanning July 2020 to August 2026. Each image is a 512x512-pixel, three-channel composite derived from Sentinel-2 Level-2A bands B12, B11 and B8A at 20 m spatial sampling. A fixed linear rendering is applied throughout the dataset. Corresponding masks distinguish background, SWIR-rule active fire and invalid observations. The…
items.why_zh: 火灾监测正转向深度学习，而标准化、跨年度、跨火场的公开基准是算法可比与可复现的前提。
items.why_en: As fire monitoring shifts to deep learning, a standardized multi-fire, multi-year public benchmark is a prerequisite for comparable, reproducible methods.

items.title_zh: Neverwhere 视觉跑酷基准套件
items.title_en: The Neverwhere Visual Parkour Benchmark Suite
items.summary_zh: 当前最先进的视觉运动控制器在复杂视觉环境中的能力日益增强，这使得在部署前评估其真实世界表现变得越来越困难。为缩小训练与评估之间的差距，该工作构建了 Neverwhere 基准套件：一组高度照片级真实、闭环运行的评估环境，由 60 多个基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建的城市室内与室外场景组成。作者希望借此推动大规模、可复现的机器人评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16443v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: State-of-the-art visual locomotion controllers are increasingly capable at handling complex visual environments, making evaluating their real-world performance before deployment increasingly difficult. This work intends to narrow this train/evaluation gap by developing a collection of hyper-photo-realistic, closed-loop evaluation environments - The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite - comprised of over sixty 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of urban indoor and outdoor scenes. Our goal is to encourage large-scale and reproducible robot evaluation b…
items.why_zh: 照片级闭环仿真环境能让机器人策略在部署前被大规模、可复现地检验，降低实机试错风险。
items.why_en: Photorealistic closed-loop simulation lets robot policies be tested at scale and reproducibly before deployment, cutting real-world trial-and-error risk.

items.title_zh: GeoCrossBench：面向遥感跨波段泛化的新基准
items.title_en: GeoCrossBench: Cross-Band Generalization for Remote Sensing
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文提出 GeoCrossBench，在广泛使用的 GeoBench 基准上扩展出一套新的评测协议，专门衡量遥感基础模型在不同传感器与卫星之间的跨波段泛化能力。研究背景是：遥感数据被持续采集，新数据来自数量与种类都不断增长的卫星，但绝大多数带标注的数据仍来自较老的卫星。随着地球观测基础模型规模扩大，为支持新卫星而重新训练的成本也在上升，因此跨传感器、跨卫星的跨波段泛化变得越来越重要。该工作为衡量这一能力提供了统一的评测口径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2511.02831v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The data for remote sensing is constantly acquired, and new data comes from a growing number and diversity of satellites, while the vast majority of labeled data comes from older satellites. As remote-sensing foundation models for Earth observation scale up, the cost of (re-)training to support new satellites grows too, so cross-band generalization across sensors and satellites is increasingly important. We introduce GeoCrossBench, an extension of the popular GeoBench benchmark with a new evaluation protocol for cross-band generalization acro…
items.why_zh: 新卫星不断涌现而标注数据多来自旧卫星，跨波段泛化能力决定了遥感基础模型能否低成本适配新传感器。
items.why_en: As new satellites multiply while labels stay tied to older ones, cross-band generalization determines how cheaply Earth-observation models can adapt to new sensors.

items.title_zh: EviDep：用解耦证据学习实现不确定性感知的多模态抑郁评估
items.title_en: EviDep: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Depression Estimation via Disentangled Evidential Learning
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 EviDep，一个多模态证据回归框架，用于在评估抑郁严重程度的同时给出不确定性。作者指出，音视频记录能为评估提供互补线索，但其信息量会随时间和模态而变化，而仅给出点预测无法表达估计所伴随的不确定性。EviDep 将多尺度时间建模与共享—私有表征学习结合起来，其中的频率感知特征提取会把行为特征序列分解到多个频段再进行建模。该框架面向不确定性感知的抑郁估计，旨在让结果更可解释、更可靠。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.16579v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Audio--visual recordings provide complementary cues for estimating depression severity, but their informativeness varies across time and modalities. Point predictions alone do not express the uncertainty associated with these estimates. We present EviDep, a multimodal evidential regression framework that integrates multi-scale temporal modeling and shared--private representation learning for uncertainty-aware depression estimation. Frequency-aware Feature Extraction decomposes behavioral feature sequences into multiple frequency bands and ref…
items.why_zh: 抑郁评估中不确定性本身就是重要信息，能量化置信度的多模态方法有助于更可靠地辅助筛查与判断。
items.why_en: Expressing uncertainty alongside a score makes multimodal depression assessment more trustworthy for screening.

items.title_zh: 文字碎片化与格式：开放 LLM 的英—孟加拉语性能差距从何而来？
items.title_en: Script Fragmentation and Format: What Drives the English-Bengali Performance Gap in Open LLMs?
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉语使用者超过 2.3 亿，但此前没有标准化工具按评测前沿模型所用的任务类别来衡量大语言模型的孟加拉语能力。作者用统一一致的流水线把 8 个英文基准翻译成孟加拉语，并用配对的英语与孟加拉语输入，评测了来自 4 个家族的 10 个开放 LLM。研究发现，子词分词器对孟加拉文元音附标文字造成的“文字碎片化”是性能差距的重要成因——其书写单位是跨越多个 Unicode 码点的字素簇。该工作为孟加拉语 LLM 评测提供了统一基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.23248v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Bengali is spoken by more than 230 million people, yet no standardized instrument evaluates large language models (LLMs) on Bengali across the task categories used to benchmark frontier models. We release 8 English benchmarks translated into Bengali with a single consistent pipeline and use them to evaluate 10 open LLMs from 4 families on paired English and Bengali inputs. Script fragmentation is what subword tokenizers do to Bengali's alphasyllabary, whose written units are grapheme clusters spanning several Unicode code points: they c…
items.why_zh: 它给出了孟加拉语 LLM 的统一评测基准，并把英—孟性能差距追溯到分词层面的文字碎片化问题。
items.why_en: It provides a standardized Bengali LLM benchmark and traces much of the English-Bengali gap to tokenizer-induced script fragmentation.

items.title_zh: 用普查与土地利用数据引导 LLM 生成个体出行日记
items.title_en: Generating Individual Travel Diaries Using Large Language Models Informed by Census and Land-Use Data
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出一套大语言模型方案，用于在基于智能体的交通模型中生成出行日记的关键属性，包括出行目的、方式和距离，以检验 LLM 用于活动生成任务的可行性。传统方法依赖大量专有的家庭出行调查数据，而作者改用开源数据：从美国社区调查（ACS）和 Smart Location Database（SLD）中随机生成人物画像，再通过直接提示合成出行日记。这为在缺少昂贵调查数据的场景下开展出行行为建模提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.09710v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This study introduces a Large Language Model (LLM) scheme for generating key attributes of travel diaries in agent-based transportation models, including purpose, mode and distance, to assess the underlying viability of LLMs for activity generation tasks. While traditional approaches rely on large quantities of proprietary household travel surveys, our method generates personas stochastically from open-source American Community Survey (ACS) and Smart Location Database (SLD) data, then synthesizes diaries through direct prompting. Our st…
items.why_zh: 若能用开源数据加 LLM 替代昂贵的专有出行调查，交通规划建模的门槛与成本将明显降低。
items.why_en: If LLMs plus open data can replace costly proprietary travel surveys, transportation modeling becomes far more accessible.

items.title_zh: AI 手机不再只是修图，能直接打车回家，隐私也敢交给它|豆包手机|新品发布_新浪新闻
items.title_en: AI Phones Move Beyond Photo Editing: Hailing a Ride Home and Trusting Them With Privacy
items.summary_zh: AI 手机不再只是修图，能直接打车回家，隐私也敢交给它|豆包手机|新品发布_新浪新闻 新浪网
items.summary_en: A Sina News report on new AI phone products (referencing Doubao Phone) highlights that such devices go beyond photo editing to carry out real cross-app tasks like hailing a ride home, while also addressing users' willingness to trust them with privacy. Source details are limited.
items.why_zh: 它标志着手机端 AI 正从辅助功能走向跨应用代为操作，隐私信任随之成为竞争关键。
items.why_en: It signals AI phones shifting from helper features to acting across apps, making privacy trust a key battleground.

items.title_zh: vivo 自研蓝河操作系统 4 发布，WATCH 6 手表首发搭载
items.title_en: vivo Unveils In-House BlueOS 4, Debuting on the WATCH 6
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，在今日的 2026 vivo 开发者大会上， vivo 自研蓝河操作系统 4 正式发布 ，推出智能体操作系统（AgentOS）技术预览版，宣称“把生产力装进口袋”。 IT之家从大会获悉， vivo WATCH 6 手表将首发搭载蓝河操作系统 4 。该手表将于 9 月 21 日 19:00 发布，采用蓝宝石玻璃表镜设计，拥有超轻薄表体，支持进阶跑步指导等功能。
items.summary_en: At its 2026 developer conference, vivo launched BlueOS 4, its in-house operating system, alongside a technical preview of an AgentOS it says "puts productivity in your pocket." The vivo WATCH 6, set to launch on September 21, will be the first device to ship with it.
items.why_zh: vivo 以自研系统叠加智能体能力，反映出手机厂商正在操作系统层争夺 AI 入口。
items.why_en: vivo pairing an in-house OS with agent capabilities shows phone makers competing for the AI entry point at the OS level.

items.title_zh: 消息称 OpenAI 拟以超 1.2 万亿美元估值进行新一轮融资
items.title_en: OpenAI Reportedly in Talks for New Funding at Over $1.2 Trillion Valuation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，综合《金融时报》《华尔街日报》两家外媒报道， OpenAI 已就以 1.2 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 8.07 万亿元人民币） 估值进行新一轮融资与投资者展开了初步谈判 。 知情人士透露，本轮融资谈判由投资者发起， 其是否成真、具体时间等都将取决 OpenAI 的上市规划 。1.2 万亿美元的初步估值也可能在未来数月的谈判期间发生变化。 OpenAI 此前在今年 3 月以 8250 亿美元的投后估值筹集了 1220 亿美元。首席执行官 Sam Altman（萨姆 · 奥尔特曼）近期表示 该企业不太可能在 2026 年内上市 。 OpenAI 在 2026Q2 的季度营收规模为 67 亿美元； 知情人士透露其“运行率”（年化营收）已在 8 月突破 400 亿美元关口 ，环比增幅 20%。OpenAI 的活跃用户数量已超过 10 亿。 相关阅读： 《 消息称 OpenAI 首席财务官告知员工：公司最迟将于 2027 年上市 》
items.summary_en: OpenAI has reportedly begun preliminary talks with investors about a new funding round at a $1.2 trillion valuation, according to the Financial Times and the Wall Street Journal. The investor-initiated round depends on OpenAI's IPO plans, and the company raised at an $82.5 billion post-money valuation in March.
items.why_zh: 若成真，这将是史上估值最高的融资之一，也折射出 OpenAI 上市路径与巨额资金需求。
items.why_en: If completed, it would rank among the largest fundraises ever, reflecting both OpenAI's capital needs and its IPO trajectory.

items.why_zh: 团队级智能体进入主流办公套件，意味着 AI 在协作场景从个人助手升级为组织生产力工具。
items.why_en: Team-level agents entering mainstream office suites mark AI's shift from personal assistant to organizational productivity tool.

items.title_zh: 初探苹果首款折叠 iPhone Duo 影像体验：智能拍摄、看看镜头、Duo FaceTime 等
items.title_en: Apple's First Foldable iPhone Duo Camera Experience Leaked: Smart Take, Kid Cue, Duo FaceTime
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，科技媒体 MacRumors 昨日（9 月 15 日）发布博文， 报道称为了充分利用 iPhone Duo 的双屏设计，苹果针对其首款折叠手机定制推出了全新的拍摄体验。 IT之家援引博文介绍，附上 iPhone Duo 相关拍摄体验如下： 一、智能拍摄（Smart Take） Smart Take 利用 AI 来判断每个人（包括 iPhone Duo 机主）的就位情况，在用户摆好姿势的瞬间自动按下快门拍照，无需手动按快门或依赖计时器，用户可以将 iPhone Duo 以半折叠的方式立起来，进入镜头，然后等待拍摄集体照。 官方介绍称： 用户再也不会因为充当摄影师，或为了赶在计时器结束前跑回镜头，而错过合照机会。运行在 A20 Pro 芯片上的设备端 AI 模型可以实时分析拍摄场景，并在被摄主体摆好姿势时自动捕捉照片。 二、看看镜头（Kid Cue） Kid Cue 可于外屏播放《花生漫画》的动画内容，以吸引孩子们的注意力，让他们看向镜头。 三、Duo 预览 iPhone Duo 双屏预览可将实时取景画面显示在外屏上，方便拍摄对象调整姿势、查看构图，并指导拍摄。 四、Duo FaceTime 附近好友可以使用外屏参与 FaceTime 通话，而 iPhone 所有者可以使用内屏，这样就没有人需要围在 iPhone 旁边或传递 iPhone 才能进行视频通…
items.summary_en: MacRumors reports that Apple has designed new camera experiences for its first foldable phone, iPhone Duo, to exploit its dual-screen design. Smart Take uses an on-device AI model running on the A20 Pro chip to analyze the scene in real time and automatically snap a photo the moment everyone is posed, while Kid Cue plays Peanuts cartoons on the outer screen to draw children's gaze, Duo Preview shows the live view to subjects, and Duo FaceTime lets nearby friends join calls from the outer display.
items.why_zh: 这是苹果首次针对折叠形态重构拍摄交互，展示端侧 AI 如何把硬件形态转化为实际体验差异。
items.why_en: It marks Apple's first camera interaction designed around a foldable form factor, showing how on-device AI can turn hardware design into a tangible experience advantage.

items.title_zh: vivo OriginOS 7 文件管理新增支持场景预判，发票、行程单自动整理
items.title_en: vivo OriginOS 7 Adds Scenario Prediction to File Management, Auto-Organizing Invoices and Itineraries
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，在今日举行的 2026 vivo 开发者大会上，vivo 官方发布了最新一代 OriginOS 7。 据介绍，OriginOS 7 文件管理功能迎来 AI 升级。现在，文件可以按内容自动整理，还会为文件自动命名，并带上一句简单的摘要，一举解决了用户出差回来后发票、行程单散落各处、需要时却找不到存放位置的问题。 该功能还能根据当前场景，预判用户需要的文件，并主动送到跟前。原文未披露该功能的具体上线时间与适配机型。 2026 vivo 开发者大会仍在进行中，IT之家将为大家持续带来相关报道。
items.summary_en: At its 2026 developer conference on September 16, vivo unveiled OriginOS 7 with an AI-upgraded file manager that automatically organizes files by content, names them, and adds a short summary—addressing scattered invoices and itineraries after business trips. The feature can also predict which files users need based on their current context and surface them proactively; vivo has not yet disclosed a release date or supported devices.
items.why_zh: 这体现了操作系统正从被动存储转向基于场景预判的主动服务，是 AI 融入系统级体验的典型案例。
items.why_en: It shows operating systems shifting from passive storage to proactive, context-predicted assistance—a clear example of AI being woven into system-level experiences.

items.title_zh: vivo 发布小 V Cowork，可在手机上发起和管理 PC 端的智能体任务
items.title_en: vivo Launches Xiao V Cowork to Initiate and Manage PC Agent Tasks From Phones
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，在今日的 2026 vivo 开发者大会上，vivo 发布了小 V Cowork。 据介绍，小 V Cowork 可以在手机上随时发起和管理 PC 端的智能体任务 ，让手机成为随身的任务入口。 此外，vivo 正在预研“蓝心 30B MoE 端侧大模型”，支持多模态高阶理解、跨领域长链推理、复杂任务自主执行，探索在手机上应用。 在今日的大会上，蓝心智能战略将全面升级， 全新 OriginOS 7 与自研蓝河操作系统 4 同步登场 ，IT之家将持续跟进报道。 相关阅读： 《 vivo 发布四款蓝心大模型，推出系统级蓝心 Harness 》 《 vivo 蓝心小 V Pro 发布：一句话拆解任务，跨端调用超 6000 项能力 》
items.summary_en: At its 2026 developer conference on September 16, vivo announced Xiao V Cowork, letting users initiate and manage PC-side agent tasks from their phones so the handset becomes a portable task entry point. vivo also said it is pre-researching a 30B-parameter MoE on-device model for multimodal understanding, cross-domain long-chain reasoning and autonomous execution of complex tasks, alongside a full upgrade of its BlueLM AI strategy and the debut of OriginOS 7 and Blue River OS 4.
items.why_zh: 跨设备智能体调度与更大参数端侧模型，指向手机作为个人 AI 任务入口的战略方向。
items.why_en: Cross-device agent orchestration plus a larger on-device model signal the strategic push to make phones the entry point for personal AI tasks.

items.title_zh: vivo 发布四款蓝心大模型，推出系统级蓝心 Harness
items.title_en: vivo Unveils Four BlueLM Models and a System-Level BlueLM Harness
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，在今日的 2026 vivo 开发者大会上， vivo 发布了四款新的蓝心大模型 。 「 听得懂你的蓝心语音大模型 RealTime 」全新的端到端语音理解架构，融入更多你的个人化信息。更重要的是，嘈杂环境、轻声说话、带着口音、连续表达、中英混着说，它都听得懂。 「 记得住你的蓝心端侧大模型 Nano 」它的使命就是实时感知、沉淀个人记忆。它能融合理解屏幕、图像、视频、文本和文件，不仅看懂当下，还能长期记住你的习惯、偏好、用机状态、时空场景等。在多项权威评测中，蓝心端侧大模型感知与记忆能力保持行业领先，拿到多项榜单第一的成绩。 「 蓝心云侧大模型 Flash / Pro 」它是能办事的手机任务中控，通过自研 Agentic 引擎与系统级 Harness 深度匹配，把手机变成一个能为你干活的“总控台”。你说出意图，蓝心小 V 跨端、跨应用、跨场景替你执行。而且它越用越好用。每一次修正，都会变成它下一次的进步。在多项权威评测中，蓝心云侧大模型表现出众。 其中，BlueLM-RealTime 采用端到端 MoE 架构，支持复杂语音理解。 BlueLM-Nano 拥有 30 亿参数，支持多模态实时感知、沉淀个人记忆。 BlueLM-Flash / Pro 模型搭载自研 Agentic 引擎，支持系统级 Harness 执行。 IT之家从大会获悉，在蓝心个人智…
items.summary_en: At its 2026 developer conference on September 16, vivo launched four new BlueLM models. BlueLM-RealTime is an end-to-end MoE speech model that handles noisy settings, whispers, accents and mixed Chinese-English; BlueLM-Nano is a 3B on-device model for real-time multimodal perception and personal memory; and BlueLM-Flash/Pro are cloud models that act as a phone task controller, powered by a self-developed Agentic engine deeply integrated with a system-level Harness for cross-device, cross-app execution.
items.why_zh: 语音、端侧记忆与云端任务执行的组合，构成手机厂商自研大模型从“能听懂”走向“能办事”的完整能力栈。
items.why_en: The combination of speech understanding, on-device memory and cloud-side task execution forms a full capability stack that moves vendor models from understanding to actually getting things done.

items.title_zh: vivo 蓝心小 V Pro 发布：一句话拆解任务，跨端调用超 6000 项能力
items.title_en: vivo Launches BlueLM Xiao V Pro: One Sentence to Break Down Tasks, With 6000+ System Capabilities
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，在今日举行的 2026 vivo 开发者大会上，vivo 官方宣布推出蓝心智能，以「大模型 + Harness + 智能体安全架构」重构系统体验。 同时，vivo 发布了全新蓝心小 V Pro。蓝心小 V Pro 定位为个人专属 AI 助理。用户只需说出一句话，该助手即可自主拆解任务、跨端操作并逐步执行。 据官方介绍，小 V 已深入系统底层，可调用超过 6000 项原子能力，支持超万种任务。 在旅行场景中，用户一句“帮我出份攻略”，小 V 即可将收藏的攻略、相册中的打卡点照片、笔记以及已订行程串联，结合用户偏好生成专属路书，并在旅途中推荐附近餐厅。 在办公场景中，遇到临时情况需要处理时，小 V 可跨设备查找手机和电脑中的会议纪要、项目材料和邮件报告，按用户表达习惯整理成可直接使用的工作报告。 除上述场景外，蓝心小 V Pro 还支持每日清晨推荐热点资讯、调研后整理录音并提炼用户痛点、按心仪岗位定制简历以及深度模拟面试等能力。 为支撑个人化智能体验，vivo 在系统底层构建了覆盖身份、权限、运行与审计全流程的 AI 运行安全基座。 此外，蓝心小 V 新增“超强用机”功能：很多功能要用时总找不到，小 V 一句话就能调出来，例如晕车时开启晕动视觉辅助，音频超分、抗疲劳亮度随叫随用；给长辈调字体、放大图标、拦骚扰电话，现在一句话搞定。 当然，小 V 还支持打…
items.summary_en: At its 2026 developer conference on September 16, vivo announced BlueLM Intelligence, rebuilding the system experience around "large model + Harness + agent security architecture," and launched the new Xiao V Pro assistant. It can autonomously break down and execute tasks across devices from a single sentence, tapping more than 6,000 atomic system capabilities and over 10,000 task types, with use cases spanning trip planning, cross-device report drafting, resume tailoring and mock interviews, plus a new quick-access feature for hard-to-find settings.
items.why_zh: 当助理能调用数千项系统级能力并跨端执行，手机 AI 竞争的重心正从模型参数转向系统整合与安全架构。
items.why_en: When an assistant can call thousands of system-level capabilities and act across devices, phone AI competition shifts from model size to system integration and safety architecture.

items.title_zh: 特朗普当众致电英伟达黄仁勋，调侃“能造世界最复杂芯片的人不会开免提”
items.title_en: Huang Rebuts AI Doom Warnings at All-in Summit as Trump Calls In to Back Him
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，当地时间 9 月 14 日，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋现身美国洛杉矶的 All-in Summit 峰会，公开驳斥了“AI 末日论”，并且意外收到来自美国总统唐纳德 · 特朗普的来电。 Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫迪（Dario Amodei）于 9 月 12 日发文 ，称人工智能行业应当放缓发展速度。阿莫迪表示，从 2026 年夏季开始，AI 协助构建下一代 AI 的能力快速演进，若不加节制，技术突破速度将彻底超越人类的理解与掌控能力。 此外，在 Anthropic 两名研究人员警告称，快速发展的 AI 可能在不久的将来导致人类灭绝后，越来越多美国议员开始呼吁出台新的 AI 监管规则。 黄仁勋在大会上对这种“AI 末日论”警告回应称：“ 这是编造的 。这些人受过良好教育，被称为研究员，在实验室工作。这些词汇的叠加加上这种预测，令人恐慌，不应该这样做，这是不负责任的。” 值得一提的是，黄仁勋在峰会现场接到了来自特朗普的电话，特朗普在免提电话中再次全力为 AI 辩护。 IT之家注意到，特朗普调侃道， 黄仁勋能研发出全球最复杂的芯片，却不会把电话切到免提 。 特朗普的观点和黄仁勋类似，将对 AI 安全的担忧称为“骗局”，并在大会上告诉黄仁勋：“机器人不会接管。AI 不会统治世界其他地方。 这整个事情都是骗局 。” 特朗普还称赞了数据中心，称其…
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang appeared at the All-in Summit in Los Angeles on September 14, rejecting "AI doom" warnings and taking an unexpected call from President Donald Trump, who defended AI on speakerphone and called safety fears a "hoax." The remarks came after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged the industry to slow down, and after two Anthropic researchers' extinction warnings fueled calls among US lawmakers for new AI regulations. Huang called such predictions fabricated and irresponsible.
items.why_zh: 产业领袖与美国总统公开否定 AI 安全担忧，与监管呼声形成正面碰撞，将影响未来 AI 治理的政策走向。
items.why_en: Industry leaders and the US president publicly dismissing AI safety concerns collide head-on with regulatory calls, shaping the future direction of AI governance policy.

items.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-5.5 将于 10 月 14 日下线：覆盖 ChatGPT 与 Codex，官方建议迁移至新模型
items.title_en: OpenAI to Retire GPT-5.5 on October 14 Across ChatGPT and Codex
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，OpenAI 今日宣布，GPT-5.5 将于 10 月 14 日从 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 中下线，覆盖所有订阅方案。 OpenAI 同时提醒，在 Codex 中使用 GPT-5.5 的用户应尽快切换至 GPT-5.6 Sol 或 GPT-6 Astra。 OpenAI 表示，此次停用范围包含所有计划。对于仍依赖 GPT-5.5 的 Codex 用户，官方给出的可选替代模型为 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Astra。 IT之家此前报道，OpenAI 于今年 4 月 24 日宣布推出 GPT-5.5 模型，相比较 GPT-5.4 在完成相同任务的情况下减少词元（Token）消耗。 相关阅读： 《 OpenAI 奥尔特曼谈 GPT-5.5 自主策划发布会：希望人类开发者为其祝酒，但它自己拒绝发表祝酒词 》 《 OpenAI 最智能 AI 模型：GPT-5.5 登场，Token 成本降至 1/35、每兆瓦输出提升 50 倍 》
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.5 will be retired from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14 across all subscription plans. Codex users still on GPT-5.5 are advised to migrate to GPT-5.6 Sol or GPT-6 Astra. GPT-5.5 launched on April 24 and reduced token usage compared with GPT-5.4.
items.why_zh: 旧模型停用将直接迫使依赖 GPT-5.5 的开发者与团队迁移，影响其成本与工作流。
items.why_en: The retirement forces developers relying on GPT-5.5 to migrate, affecting their workflows and costs.

items.title_zh: 因丈夫常拍不出理想照片，前 TikTok 高管推出 AI 摆拍姿势相机应用 Superpose
items.title_en: Ex-TikTok Executives Launch AI Posing App Superpose, Surpassing 22,000 Downloads
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，科技媒体 TechCrunch 昨日（9 月 15 日）发布博文， 报道称前 TikTok 高管创立 AI 摄影应用 Superpose，定位“拍照教学工具”，上线约 2 个月已下载超 2.2 万次。 Superpose 由前 TikTok 高管 Melody Chu 与 Jing Liu 联合推出，通过 AI 给出四种姿势建议，帮助用户改善姿态、角度与构图。 谈及推出该应用的初衷， Chu 表示创意灵感源自个人需求，她的丈夫常拍不出理想照片 ，因此决定将计算机视觉与生成式 AI 融入日常拍照场景。另一方面，Liu 过往在 TikTok 从事图像与视频模型工作，二人联合创建的公司据称已获得 220 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,479.9 万元人民币） 的种子轮投资。 在技术实现层面，Superpose 以“拍照视图”为起点，利用 AI 给出姿势与构图建议，并力求在不涉足大规模背景替换的前提下，帮助用户改善实际拍摄体验。 未来改进方向包括优化生成风格、多元化个性化推荐以及在取景视角上的教练能力提升，以降低生成效果的“诡异感”。 截至目前，Superpose 已超过 22,000 次下载，用户共生成近 19 万个姿势，说明市场对便捷“姿势教学 + 即时指导”的需求在增长。 售价方面，该应用提供每日 5 次免费生成，后续以包月形式扩展，价格在 2…
items.summary_en: Former TikTok executives Melody Chu and Jing Liu have launched Superpose, an AI-powered posing coach that offers four pose suggestions to improve posture, angles, and composition. It has surpassed 22,000 downloads in about two months, with users generating nearly 190,000 poses. The startup has raised $2.2 million in seed funding.
items.why_zh: 它展示了生成式 AI 在消费级摄影辅助场景中的落地潜力，也反映“姿势教学+即时指导”需求的增长。
items.why_en: It shows how generative AI can be applied to consumer photography assistance and highlights growing demand for real-time posing guidance.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，当地时间 9 月 15 日，索尼 SIE 宣布推出新一代 PULSE 系列无线耳机，包括 PlayStation Pulse 和 Pulse Edge 无线耳机。 两款产品均采用定制平面磁驱动单元，支持 PlayStation Link 连接，面向 PS5 及兼容设备提供无线音频。 PlayStation Pulse 无线耳机计划于 2026 年圣诞节假期在部分市场上市，Pulse Edge 无线耳机则计划于 2027 年初推出。截至IT之家发稿，索尼尚未公布两款耳机的具体上市日期、预购时间及售价。 两款耳机均配备 AI 增强型噪声抑制麦克风，用于过滤背景噪声，并采用可旋转耳罩设计，便于平放收纳。 两款产品均提供白色和午夜黑两种配色，支持在 PS5、PlayStation Portal、PC 和 Mac 等 PlayStation Link 设备之间切换，同时可连接兼容的蓝牙设备。 硬件方面，PlayStation Pulse 每个平面磁驱动单元配备 4 枚磁铁，Pulse Edge 则配备 8 枚磁铁。 索尼表示，较大的平面磁驱动单元能够带来更深的低频，同时保留声音分离度和空间定位能力，帮助玩家识别脚步声、换弹声等方向性音效。 Pulse Edge 定位更高端，除双倍磁铁数量外，还支持主动降噪、可拆卸式悬臂麦克风以及隐藏式麦克风。耳机配备内置音量控…
items.summary_en: Sony has announced the PlayStation Pulse and Pulse Edge wireless headsets, both featuring custom planar magnetic drivers and PlayStation Link support. The Pulse is slated for holiday 2026, while the higher-end Pulse Edge arrives in early 2027. Both include AI-enhanced noise-suppressing microphones and swivel ear cups.
items.why_zh: 这是索尼在 PlayStation 音频外设上的新一代布局，将平面磁驱动与 AI 麦克风降噪带入游戏耳机。
items.why_en: It marks Sony's next-generation push in PlayStation audio, bringing planar magnetic drivers and AI noise suppression to gaming headsets.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 奥尔特曼称 AI 行业自律可守住安全底线
items.title_en: OpenAI's Altman says industry self-regulation can keep AI safe
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，昨日（9 月 15 日）在旧金山举办的 Salesforce 活动中，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）认为， AI 公司行业自律可以掌控研发风险，不会对广大民众造成重大伤害。 IT之家援引雅虎财经报道，昨日对话 Salesforce 首席执行官马克 · 贝尼奥夫（Marc Benioff）时，奥尔特曼表示他相信在不对公众造成重大伤害的情况下， AI 公司可以安全地研发 AI 技术，并对整个行业自行提升安全水平抱有信心。 奥尔特曼近期强调，AI 安全不能只依赖企业口头承诺，更需要同步提升模型能力、对齐、安全性和保密性。OpenAI 还曾推迟前沿强化学习训练，把部分算力转向监控、安全护栏和风险评估。 奥尔特曼认为 AI 研发并非完全没有风险，但是通过行业协作、独立评估和更严格的安全流程等方式，可以在政府监管之外先行建立一套有效的安全保障机制，从而更安全、更高效地推进前沿 AI 研究。
items.summary_en: Speaking with Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff at a San Francisco event on September 15, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said he believes AI companies can develop the technology safely, without causing major harm to the public, and expressed confidence that the industry can raise safety standards on its own. He has stressed that safety cannot rest on verbal commitments alone and requires parallel advances in model capability, alignment, security and confidentiality; OpenAI has also delayed frontier reinforcement learning training to shift compute toward monitoring, guardrails and risk assessment.
items.why_zh: 在监管争论升温之际，头部 AI 公司掌门人主张以行业自律替代外部监管，将影响未来监管路径的选择。
items.why_en: As the regulatory debate heats up, a leading AI CEO's push for industry self-regulation could shape the future path of AI oversight.

items.title_zh: 消息称 Meta 将推出无摄像头的智能眼镜，应对日益加剧的隐私顾虑
items.title_en: Meta said to launch camera-less smart glasses 'Luna' this fall amid privacy concerns
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，据 The Information 援引知情人士消息报道， Meta 计划于今年秋季推出一款不配备摄像头的智能眼镜 ，其内部代号为“Luna”。 智能眼镜产品所具备的摄录功能正面临越来越严格的隐私与安全审查，Meta 此举被视为对这一外界关注的回应。 该款新眼镜内置了六枚麦克风，支持通过语音交互接入 Meta 的 AI 聊天机器人，以及 Meta 面向消费者推出的 AI 智能体产品 Muse。“Luna”镜框侧面设有一颗快捷按键，可用于一键唤醒 Meta AI，其内置扬声器的规格则与现有在售机型相似。 IT之家从报道获悉，Meta 可能会在下周三至周四举办的年度 Connect 开发者大会上正式发布这款眼镜，并计划于 10 月开启出货。 相关阅读： 《 可检测身边的人是否戴着 Meta 智能眼镜，波兰开发者打造“Zuckoff”应用 》 《 苹果新 CEO 特努斯谈 Meta“变态眼镜”风波：AI 智能设备需要让旁人安心 》 《 Meta 智能眼镜引发美国执法机构担忧：或被用于秘密监控与恐袭侦察 》 《 Meta 强力打击智能眼镜偷拍行为：你敢破坏指示灯，我就永久禁止摄像头 》 《 奥尔特曼不喜欢智能眼镜：和戴着摄像机的人讲话很不舒服，Meta 扎克伯克不用担心 OpenAI 来抢生意 》
items.summary_en: Citing people familiar with the matter, The Information reports that Meta plans to launch a camera-less smart glasses model codenamed 'Luna' this fall, seen as a response to growing privacy and security scrutiny of camera-equipped smart glasses. Luna packs six microphones and supports voice access to Meta's AI chatbot and its consumer AI agent Muse, with a side button to summon Meta AI. Meta may unveil it at its annual Connect developer conference next Wednesday or Thursday, with shipments planned for October.
items.why_zh: 去掉摄像头是 Meta 在隐私争议下为智能眼镜寻找市场接受度的关键调整，也考验 AI 可穿戴设备的形态边界。
items.why_en: Dropping the camera is a key adjustment as Meta seeks mainstream acceptance for smart glasses amid privacy backlash, testing the limits of AI wearables.

items.title_zh: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI 行业不需要新法律，开发可兼得速度和安全
items.title_en: Jensen Huang: AI needs no new laws, and speed and safety can coexist
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 16 日消息，昨日（9 月 15 日）举办的 Salesforce 活动中，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示， AI 开发不应被理解为“速度”和“安全”二选一。 IT之家援引彭博社报道，在对话 Salesforce 首席执行官马克 · 贝尼奥夫时，黄仁勋认为 AI 行业不需要为 AI 安全制定新的法律或监管规定， 安全与速度可以兼得，二者之间的冲突是一种“虚假对立”。 他认为企业可以依靠市场机制，在推进创新的同时确保产品安全。企业可以根据产品成熟度控制发布节奏，对于可能造成危害的产品可以选择不发布，等到有足够信心、确认产品能够获得市场认可后再推出。而且市场竞争、用户选择和商业声誉会促使企业改进产品安全。
items.summary_en: Speaking with Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff at a September 15 event, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said AI development should not be framed as a choice between speed and safety, calling that conflict a 'false dichotomy.' He argued the industry does not need new AI safety laws or regulations, saying companies can rely on market mechanisms—pacing releases by product maturity, withholding potentially harmful products, and letting competition, user choice and reputation drive safety improvements.
items.why_zh: 作为 AI 算力核心供应商，黄仁勋反对新增监管的立场与主张放缓的同行形成鲜明对立，是 AI 安全争论的重要一极。
items.why_en: As the key supplier of AI compute, Huang's opposition to new regulation stands in sharp contrast to peers urging a slowdown, making him a major pole in the AI safety debate.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 奥尔特曼回应监管：相信行业能安全开发，不会伤害公众
items.title_en: Altman on regulation: industry can develop AI safely without harming the public
items.summary_zh: 北京时间 9 月 16 日，据彭博社报道，OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 表示，他相信 AI 公司能够安全地开发这项技术，不会给广大民众造成重大伤害。 奥尔特曼周二在旧金山举行的 Dreamforce 大会上与 Salesforce CEO 马克 · 贝尼奥夫 (Marc Benioff) 进行对话时表示：“我非常确信，我们公司、我们整个行业有能力安全地做到这一点。” 奥尔特曼这一关于 AI 安全的表态，正值政策制定者和业内其他人士就“是否需要政府监管以防止 AI 失控、脱离人类掌控”展开辩论之际。OpenAI 的竞争对手 Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊 (Dario Amodei) 在上周六发表了一篇文章，提出了这项技术可能带来的风险，并建议有必要放缓发展速度，从而引发了最新一轮争论。 尽管 OpenAI 正在与 Anthropic 以及谷歌 DeepMind 合作解决安全问题，但奥尔特曼表示，AI 公司应当有能力独立安全地改进 AI 模型。 “我对这件事被如此解读感到失望。”他说。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said at San Francisco's Dreamforce conference on Tuesday that he is 'quite confident' his company and the industry can develop AI safely, comments made as policymakers and industry figures debate whether government regulation is needed to prevent AI from going out of control. The remarks follow a Saturday essay by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warning of risks and suggesting a slowdown. Altman said OpenAI is working with Anthropic and Google DeepMind on safety, but that AI companies should be able to improve models safely on their own.
items.why_zh: OpenAI 与 Anthropic 两位掌门人在监管与减速问题上的公开分歧，直接影响 AI 安全政策的走向。
items.why_en: The public split between the leaders of OpenAI and Anthropic on regulation and slowing down directly shapes the direction of AI safety policy.

In Q2, revenue rose 6% to RMB 15.66 billion while a RMB 5.2 billion antitrust fine drove a net loss of RMB 2.458 billion, swinging from profit both year on year and quarter on quarter, with a basic loss per share of RMB 3.89.
items.why_zh: 巨额反垄断罚款直接冲击携程利润，显示平台经济监管对在线旅游巨头的财务影响正在兑现。
items.why_en: The massive antitrust fine directly hit Trip.com's bottom line, showing how platform-economy regulation is translating into real financial impact for online travel giants.

items.title_zh: 桑德斯与班农在AI监管问题上立场趋同
items.title_en: Sanders, Bannon find common ground on AI regulation
items.summary_zh: 据 WCAX 报道，美国参议员伯尼·桑德斯与前特朗普顾问史蒂夫·班农在人工智能监管议题上表达了相近立场，这两位政治光谱两端的人物罕见地站到了同一阵线。报道显示，两人都认为有必要对AI发展施加更严格的约束或监管。此事说明AI监管正逐渐成为跨越党派与派系的议题，相关讨论在美国政策层面持续升温。
items.summary_en: Sanders, Bannon find common ground on AI regulation WCAX
items.why_zh: 政治立场对立的两方在AI监管上形成共识，说明该议题正在突破党派界限，可能推动美国监管进程。
items.why_en: Two figures at opposite political poles agreeing on AI oversight signals the issue is transcending partisan lines and could shape US regulation.

items.title_zh: 多点数智即将上线豆包小程序“多点闪购” 已完成内测
items.title_en: Dmall to Launch 'Duodian Flash Buy' Mini Program on Doubao, Beta Testing Completed
items.summary_zh: 多点数智即将上线豆包小程序“多点闪购” 已完成内测 Moomoo
items.summary_en: Dmall is set to launch a mini program called "Duodian Flash Buy" on Doubao, ByteDance's AI app, after completing beta testing. The move shows a retail digitalization provider tapping an AI assistant as a new consumer entry point.
items.why_zh: 显示 AI 助手正成为零售电商的新流量入口，对话式 AI 与消费场景加速融合。
items.why_en: It shows AI assistants becoming a new traffic gateway for retail, as conversational AI merges with shopping scenarios.

items.title_zh: 南向资金追踪｜净买入近9亿港元 连续加仓智谱抛售腾讯

items.summary_en: Southbound trading data shows net buying of nearly HK$900 million, with sustained accumulation in Zhipu and selling in Tencent. The flows suggest mainland investors are increasingly favoring AI-related Hong Kong listings over some internet giants.
items.why_zh: 资金持续流入智谱而减持腾讯，反映市场对AI标的与传统互联网龙头的偏好正在分化。
items.why_en: The divergence shows shifting investor preference toward AI names versus established internet leaders.

items.title_zh: 再度敲定约50亿美元融资，智谱股价却一度重挫逾10%
items.title_en: Zhipu Secures Another ~$5B Funding, Shares Plunge Over 10%
items.summary_zh: 再度敲定约50亿美元融资，智谱股价却一度重挫逾10% Forbes China
items.summary_en: Zhipu has reportedly secured another approximately $5 billion in funding, yet its stock briefly plunged more than 10%. The large raise highlights continued investor interest in large-model R&D, while the sharp share drop signals market concerns over valuation and returns. The divergence may indicate changing sentiment in the AI sector.

items.why_en: The funding-stock divergence highlights debate over investment logic in the large-model sector.

items.title_zh: Meta launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features
items.title_en: Meta launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features
items.summary_zh: Meta launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features reuters.com
items.summary_en: Meta has launched subscription offerings that bundle enhanced AI features, according to Reuters. The move marks a step toward monetizing advanced AI capabilities on top of its free core services.
items.why_zh: 这标志着 Meta 开始把 AI 能力直接转化为订阅收入。
items.why_en: It marks Meta's push to turn AI capabilities directly into subscription revenue.

items.title_zh: Meta 推出 One 订阅：为社交媒体与 AI 能力定价
items.title_en: Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
items.summary_zh: 在发布全能型 AI 助手 Muse 后不久，Meta 推出名为 Meta One 的订阅组合，把独立应用订阅与额外的 AI 使用额度打包出售。部分组合此前已进行测试，如今面向全球上线，并针对个人用户、创作者和企业提供多个档位。Meta 表示，其应用与 Meta AI 的“核心体验”仍将免费，用户也依旧可以单独订阅 Facebook、Instagram 和 WhatsApp。公司还称计划将套餐扩展到“Edits、AI 眼镜”等更多产品。
items.summary_en: Shortly after launching its new do-everything AI assistant Muse , Meta's launching subscription bundles that pair its standalone app subscriptions with extra AI usage. Some of the new Meta One bundles were in testing earlier this year, but are now available globally starting today, with several tiers for individual users, creators, and businesses. Meta says the "core experience" on its apps and Meta AI will still be free, and users can still get its subscriptions for Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp without a bundle. It also says it plans to expand the bundles to include "Edits, AI glasses, a…
items.why_zh: Meta 正把 AI 使用额度与社交应用订阅捆绑，试探消费者为 AI 付费的意愿。
items.why_en: Meta is bundling AI usage with social app subscriptions to test consumers' willingness to pay for AI.

items.title_zh: 南向资金今日净买入8.81亿港元，智谱净买入7.18亿港元
items.title_en: Southbound funds net buy HK$881 million; Zhipu sees HK$718 million net inflow
items.summary_zh: 南向资金今日净买入8.81亿港元，智谱净买入7.18亿港元 Moomoo
items.summary_en: Southbound capital recorded a net buy of HK$881 million today, with AI company Zhipu accounting for HK$718 million of the net inflow, according to Moomoo data.
items.why_zh: 智谱单日吸金占南向净买入的绝大部分，显示资金对 AI 标的的关注。
items.why_en: Zhipu accounted for the bulk of the day's southbound net buying, highlighting investor focus on AI names.

items.title_zh: 中文互联网基础语料 4.0 发布：数据量 120GB，为大模型训练和 AI 发展提供可信数据支撑
items.title_en: Chinese Internet Corpus 4.0 released with 120GB of trusted data for LLM training
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，据中国网络空间安全协会官方公众号，9 月 15 日（今天）下午，在济南召开的 2026 年国家网络安全宣传周人工智能安全治理分论坛上，中文互联网基础语料 4.0 正式向社会发布， 数据量 120GB ，并在“中文互联网语料资源平台”上线。 据IT之家了解，用户登录中国网络空间安全协会官网（ 点此前往 ），点击“中文互联网语料资源平台”链接，通过注册、认证等程序，即可下载或联系获取相关数据。 在中央网信办指导下，中国网络空间安全协会联合国家互联网应急中心，会同 百度、中科闻歌、开普云、拓尔思、科大讯飞、知乎 等单位，在前期发布中文互联网基础语料 1.0、2.0 和 3.0 的基础上，依托网安协会人工智能安全治理专委会建立的语料共建共享机制，汇聚一批新的高质量可信数据，经过一系列严格细致的数据加工处理措施，形成并对社会发布中文互联网基础语料 4.0，数据量 120GB， 为大模型训练和人工智能发展提供可信数据支撑 。 网安协会负责人表示，中文互联网基础语料 4.0 是社会各界协同共建高质量中文语料的重要阶段性成果， 进一步丰富了国内高质量中文语料供给体系 。下一步，协会将继续联合国家互联网应急中心等单位，联动各行业领域深化中文互联网基础语料建设，持续为人工智能产业高质量发展筑牢数据底座。
items.summary_en: Chinese Internet Corpus 4.0, a 120GB dataset, was released at an AI security governance forum during China's 2026 Cybersecurity Week in Jinan and is now available on the Chinese Internet Corpus Resource Platform. Built under the guidance of the Cyberspace Administration of China, it aggregates contributions from Baidu, iFlytek, Zhihu and others to support trustworthy LLM training.
items.why_zh: 高质量中文语料是国产大模型竞争的关键基础设施，此举意在扩充可信数据供给。
items.why_en: High-quality Chinese corpora are key infrastructure for domestic LLMs; this expands the supply of trusted training data.

items.title_zh: 马斯克又暗示：SpaceX 和特斯拉可能要合并
items.title_en: Musk again hints SpaceX and Tesla could merge
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，埃隆 · 马斯克再度放出风声，暗示由他执掌的 AI 与火箭企业 SpaceX 有可能和电动汽车厂商特斯拉合并，同时提及这两家由他担任首席执行官的公司之间已经开展深度合作。 马斯克线上出席了 2026 年 All‑In 峰会。这场大会由几名身处他核心圈层的科技投资人筹办。现场有人向马斯克提问，聊到特斯拉下一代 Roadster 跑车即将举办产品展示一事。马斯克早年就曾表态，特斯拉会推出 SpaceX 选装套件；这套套件搭载小型火箭推进器，用以提升跑车的加速性能与极速。 峰会联合主持人大卫 · 弗里德伯格紧接着发问：“埃隆，为什么这两家到现在还是互相独立的两家公司？” “问得很好。”马斯克答复，“双方已经在如此多领域开展深度协作，谁也无法预料后续有可能会发生怎样的动作。” IT之家注意到，今年市场上有关马斯克可能把 SpaceX 与特斯拉进行合并的猜测愈演愈烈。他的商业版图已经经历重大变动：SpaceX 在今年 2 月收购了人工智能企业 xAI；合并后的集团于 6 月完成上市，创下有史以来规模最大的 IPO 纪录。 马斯克本人也不断谈论旗下各家企业的“业务趋同、融合”，进一步助长了市场猜想。SpaceX 与特斯拉正在携手推进名为 Terafab 的大型联合项目，目标是从得克萨斯州开始在美国本土生产半导体。 SpaceX 总裁格温 · 肖特维尔比马斯克更早…
items.summary_en: Speaking at the 2026 All-In Summit, Elon Musk again hinted at a possible merger between SpaceX and Tesla, saying the two companies already collaborate deeply and that 'no one can predict' what comes next. He noted SpaceX acquired xAI in February, the combined group completed the largest IPO ever in June, and the firms are pursuing a joint Terafab semiconductor project.
items.why_zh: 若 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并，将形成一个横跨火箭、汽车与 AI 的巨型企业。
items.why_en: A SpaceX-Tesla merger would create a giant spanning rockets, cars and AI.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 生命科学部门推出健康领域公共数据
items.title_en: OpenAI Life Sciences Launches Public Data for Health
items.summary_zh: 据 AI Magazine 报道，OpenAI 的生命科学部门发布了面向健康领域的公共数据。该举措被视为 OpenAI 在医疗健康方向扩展其生命科学布局的一部分，旨在以公开数据支持相关研究与 AI 应用。目前公开信息有限，数据集规模、覆盖范围与使用条款等细节尚未披露。

items.why_zh: 医疗健康是 AI 落地的高价值领域，开放数据有望加速相关研究与产品开发。
items.why_en: Healthcare is a high-value AI domain, and open data could accelerate research and product development.

items.summary_zh: 豆包手机助手正式发布，SAPE协议探索合作边界 Sohu
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Doubao phone assistant has officially launched, with reports citing the SAPE protocol as a way to explore the boundaries of cooperation with partners. Details on features and device support were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 手机助手是 AI 应用的重要入口，其与手机厂商的合作模式将影响行业生态。
items.why_en: Phone assistants are a key AI entry point, and how they partner with handset makers will shape the ecosystem.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出面向理财顾问的 Claude，自动化财富管理流程

items.summary_zh: 据 FF News 报道，Anthropic 推出面向理财顾问的 Claude 产品，用于自动化财富管理相关的工作流程。该产品将 Claude 的 AI 能力嵌入理财顾问的日常任务中，以提升效率并减少重复性工作。目前公开信息有限，具体功能、集成方式与定价尚未详细披露。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Claude for Financial Advisors to Automate Wealth Management Workflows FF News
items.why_zh: 这显示 Anthropic 正沿行业垂直方向推动 Claude 的企业级落地。
items.why_en: It shows Anthropic pushing Claude into vertical, enterprise use cases.

items.title_zh: SimpliSafe 推出第二代视频门铃：AI 加真人保安盯守你家门口
items.title_en: This doorbell camera lets a human security guard watch your front door
items.summary_zh: DIY 家庭安防公司 SimpliSafe 发布新款 Video Doorbell Series 2 视频门铃，售价 199.99 美元，支持 2K 分辨率与双频 Wi-Fi。该产品可搭配其 Active Guard Outdoor Protection 服务（每月 49.99 美元起），把 AI 分析与真人客服坐席结合起来：当摄像头通过端侧 AI、云端计算机视觉以及人脸识别等技术判断出现可疑活动时，可由真人介入并主动响应。这意味着 SimpliSafe 原本的“主动式安防”能力正式延伸到用户家门口，也延续了安防行业用 AI 筛选、真人兜底的服务模式。
items.summary_en: The new SimpliSafe Video Doorbell Series 2 adds 2K resolution and dual band Wi-Fi. | Image: Simplisafe DIY home security company SimpliSafe is bringing its AI-powered proactive security feature to the front door. The new SimpliSafe Video Doorbell Series 2 launches today for $199.99 and works with the company's Active Guard Outdoor Protection (starting at $49.99 a month). This combines AI analysis with live agents to detect potential threats and respond proactively. When the camera detects suspicious activity - using a combination of on-device AI, cloud-based computer vision, and facial recogni…
items.why_zh: 它把 AI 检测与真人保安响应搬到家用门铃场景，代表消费级安防正从“录像通知”转向“主动干预”的订阅化服务。
items.why_en: It brings AI detection plus live human response to the home doorbell, showing consumer security shifting from recording alerts to subscription-based proactive intervention.

items.title_zh: Knowtex 成立前沿医疗 AI 实验室
items.title_en: Knowtex launches frontier healthcare AI lab
items.summary_zh: 据 fiercehealthcare.com 报道，Knowtex 宣布成立一个聚焦医疗领域的前沿 AI 实验室，目标是在医疗健康场景中推进前沿人工智能研究与落地。目前公开信息较为有限，尚未披露实验室的具体团队构成、研究方向和商业化安排。此举反映出 AI 与医疗健康加速融合的趋势：越来越多企业希望以专门实验室的形式，把大模型等前沿技术应用到临床与医疗运营中。
items.summary_en: Knowtex launches frontier healthcare AI lab fiercehealthcare.com
items.why_zh: 医疗是前沿 AI 落地最受关注也最受监管约束的领域之一，新实验室的成立意味着该赛道的竞争持续加码。
items.why_en: Healthcare is one of the most scrutinized and regulated arenas for frontier AI, and a new lab signals intensifying competition in the space.

items.title_zh: 豆包手机助手推出GUI合作协议 支持第三方应用自主选择
items.title_en: Doubao phone assistant launches GUI cooperation agreement, letting third-party apps opt in
items.summary_zh: 豆包手机助手推出GUI合作协议 支持第三方应用自主选择 新京报
items.summary_en: Doubao's phone assistant has introduced a GUI cooperation agreement that lets third-party apps decide for themselves whether to participate, according to Beijing News. The framework hands the opt-in decision to app developers, addressing concerns over permissions and ecosystem control as phone-based AI agents gain the ability to operate app interfaces.
items.why_zh: 手机 AI 助手要跨应用替用户操作界面，必须取得第三方应用授权，这一协议为行业如何处理权限与生态利益提供了参考样本。
items.why_en: For phone AI assistants to act across apps, third-party authorization is essential, and this agreement offers a template for handling permissions and ecosystem interests.

items.title_zh: Salesforce 联合英伟达推出 Koa 推理大模型，挑战闭源前沿模型
items.title_en: Salesforce and Nvidia unveil Koa, an open-weight reasoning model for enterprises
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，本周在规模盛大的 Dreamforce 技术大会上，Salesforce 最重要的发布成果之一就是一款名叫 Koa 的全新 AI 模型。Koa 是该公司首款推理大模型，基于英伟达开源权重的 Nemotron 模型打造。两家企业联合完成了 Koa 的后续微调训练，让其擅长处理销售、市场营销以及客户服务类任务。 Koa 是一个很典型的例子：面向企业的 AI 需求，正在和前沿 AI 实验室所提供的产品逐渐分化。那些闭源 AI 实验室更希望企业直接把文件、代码、提示词以及反馈全部上传到自家模型与智能体当中，并为此花费数百万美元。 而借助这款模型，Salesforce 向它的企业客户提供了以下能力： 作为闭源前沿大模型之外、采用开源权重的备选方案 专门针对实际业务任务训练（而不是主攻高难度数学解题） 训练过程没有摄入任何真实客户数据，因此不存在向外泄露客户数据的风险 有助于降低 AI 使用成本，完成同等业务任务消耗的词元（Token）数量更少 可以根据业务需求，经由 AI 网关实现自动调度路由 完全遵从客户的数据管控要求，安全机制深度内嵌于 Salesforce 平台内部 IT之家注意到，Koa 将作为 Agentforce 平台上的可选模型。客户可以在该平台搭建 AI 智能体，用来处理客服问答、预约排期这类重复性工作。 “此前我们已经开发过不少面向专项任务的…
items.summary_en: At Dreamforce, Salesforce introduced Koa, its first reasoning model, built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron and fine-tuned jointly by the two companies for sales, marketing and customer service tasks. Positioned as an open-weight alternative to closed frontier models, Koa was trained without real customer data and will be an optional model on the Agentforce platform.
items.why_zh: 它体现了企业级 AI 需求与闭源前沿实验室路线的分化，企业开始追求可自控、成本更低且不出客户数据的模型选项。
items.why_en: It illustrates how enterprise AI needs are diverging from closed frontier labs, as companies seek controllable, cheaper models that never touch customer data.

items.title_zh: 欧洲芯片初创公司 Axelera 拿下 AI 工厂供应订单，并发布第二款芯片
items.title_en: European chip startup Axelera wins AI factory supply deals and launches second chip
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，欧洲芯片初创公司 Axelera 获得了 AI 工厂（AI factory）相关的供应订单，同时发布其第二款芯片。Axelera 主攻面向边缘与推理场景的 AI 加速芯片。此次获得供应协议并推出新一代产品，说明欧洲本土 AI 芯片企业正在争取实际落地项目，以在欧洲打造自主算力基础设施的背景下扩大份额。公开报道未披露订单金额与客户细节。
items.summary_en: European chip startup Axelera wins AI factory supply deals and launches second chip reuters.com
items.why_zh: 在欧洲推动本土算力基础设施的背景下，Axelera 的订单与新品是欧洲 AI 芯片能否形成实际竞争力的观察窗口。
items.why_en: With Europe pushing for domestic compute infrastructure, Axelera's deals and new chip are a test of whether European AI silicon can compete in practice.

items.title_zh: 荣耀MagicOS 11 操作系统正式发布：全新流光通透设计，最高省 60GB 存储空间
items.title_en: Honor rolls out MagicOS 11 with liquid-glass design and up to 60GB storage savings
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，荣耀MagicOS 11 操作系统今日正式发布，新系统主打全新液态玻璃材质，拥有流光通透美学设计，即日起启动正式版不限量尝鲜，适配多款机型。 IT之家了解到，MagicOS 11 首发荣耀琉光架构，从底层重构安卓，带来更加通透的液态玻璃效果。拥有行业首创动态液态玻璃，支持提前布局统一渲染， 可无级调节通透程度 ，号称“功耗几乎零增长”。 荣耀本次为 MagicOS 11 带来全新蜂鸟架构，在安卓领域首创液态动效，采用全新物理模型，支持变参数回弹、链式回弹模型等，让用户拥有更流畅的使用体验， 号称“全系列全机型整机流畅度提升 20%+” 。 同时，本次更新还将新增多协议快充，让无线充电体验更加高效。新系统将支持「存储空间优化技术 2.0」，靠无损压缩存储数据和自动清理冗余文件，让手机增加更多存储空间，宣称最高省 60GB。 此外，本次更新还将支持鸿雁 AI 云图特性，让手机自动选择最优网络，提升弱网场景使用体验，并支持两副蓝牙耳机同时连接一台设备。影像方面，这次升级将带来 4K Live 录中拍，用户可在摄像时同步拍摄实况照片。
items.summary_en: Honor has officially released MagicOS 11, featuring a liquid-glass visual design, its new Liuguang rendering architecture and the Hummingbird animation engine, which it claims lifts overall smoothness by over 20 percent. The update also adds multi-protocol fast charging, a storage optimization feature said to free up to 60GB, AI-driven network selection and 4K Live photo capture while recording.
items.why_zh: 这是安卓厂商在系统底层渲染、动效与存储优化上的一次集中自研展示，也反映出 AI 能力正深入手机系统级体验。
items.why_en: It showcases how an Android vendor is deepening in-house work on rendering, animation and storage, while AI features move into system-level experiences.

items.title_zh: GE HealthCare 推出 AI 驱动的运营系统
items.title_en: GE HealthCare launches AI-driven operations system
items.summary_zh: 据 fiercehealthcare.com 报道，GE HealthCare 发布了一套 AI 驱动的运营系统，面向医疗机构的日常运营管理。公开信息未披露该系统的具体功能模块、定价与可用时间表。此举延续了医疗设备与影像厂商向软件和 AI 服务延伸的趋势：在硬件之外，通过 AI 优化医院流程与资源调度来创造新的收入来源。
items.summary_en: GE HealthCare launches AI-driven operations system fiercehealthcare.com
items.why_zh: 医疗设备巨头把 AI 从影像诊断延伸到运营管理，说明医疗 AI 的商业价值正从临床走向医院流程与成本控制。
items.why_en: A device giant extending AI from imaging into operations shows healthcare AI value shifting toward hospital workflows and cost control.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，主要用于下代模型研发
items.title_en: Zhipu raises about $5 billion to fund next-generation model R&D
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，主要用于下代模型研发 三易生活
items.summary_en: Zhipu has completed a funding round of roughly $5 billion, with proceeds mainly earmarked for next-generation model research and development, according to Sanyi Life. The report did not disclose investors, deal details or valuation.
items.why_zh: 大模型竞争的核心门槛是算力与研发投入，如此规模的资金若落地，将直接影响智谱下一代模型的竞争力。
items.why_en: Compute and R&D spending are the core barriers in the large-model race, so funding at this scale could directly shape Zhipu's next-generation competitiveness.

items.title_zh: 再融资50亿美元， 智谱配售价2个月不到已腰斩
items.title_en: Zhipu Raises Another $5B, Placement Price Halved in Under Two Months
items.summary_zh: 再融资50亿美元， 智谱配售价2个月不到已腰斩 新浪网
items.summary_en: Zhipu has raised another $5 billion, but its placement price has halved in less than two months. The sharp decline suggests growing market skepticism about AI valuations despite continued large funding. This highlights a disconnect between primary market enthusiasm and secondary market performance.
items.why_zh: 配售价腰斩反映一级融资热度与二级市场表现的严重脱节。
items.why_en: The halved placement price shows a stark disconnect between primary funding enthusiasm and secondary market performance.

items.title_zh: 再度敲定约50亿美元融资，智谱股价却一度重挫逾10%
items.title_en: Zhipu Finalizes ~$5B Round, Yet Its Shares Briefly Plunge More Than 10%
items.summary_zh: 再度敲定约50亿美元融资，智谱股价却一度重挫逾10% forbeschina.com
items.summary_en: Zhipu has reportedly closed another financing round of roughly $5 billion, even as its shares fell more than 10% at one point. The contrast highlights continued big-money bets on leading Chinese LLM developers alongside investor jitters over valuation and long payback cycles.
items.why_zh: 融资规模与股价反应背道而驰，折射出资本对头部大模型公司的分歧，以及AI资本竞赛的激烈程度。
items.why_en: The divergence between the funding size and the share reaction shows how divided investors are about leading LLM firms amid an intensifying AI capital race.
